name: DCM Shriram Ltd
title: DCM Shriram Ltd - 523367 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Chemicals capex cycle concluded with FY27 capex guided at INR1,000-1,200 crore, but PVC and sugar margins are squeezed; caustic utilisation ~85% with ECU INR32,000-33,000/MT.

utilisation.quote: India's caustic soda market operated at reasonable levels of about 85% capacity utilization

triggers.label: PVC prices volatile, 81-82 range
triggers.quote: Our prices are ranging between 81 -82 in that range right now.

triggers.label: Sugar inventory at historic low
triggers.quote: they are all -time historical low of about 4 million tons in the country

guidance.quote: that should be in the range of around INR1,000-INR1,200 crore including the normal capex
Yes, we expect to achieve break-even this year.

red_flags.label: Chemicals PBDIT flat, fixed costs elevated
red_flags.quote: PBDIT for the quarter was flat at INR163 crore due to elevated fixed costs

red_flags.label: Sugar margins under pressure, cane cost up 8%
red_flags.quote: profitability remains under pressure as realizations from sugar and ethanol have not offset rising sugarcane costs

red_flags.label: Net debt up to INR1,767 crore
red_flags.quote: Our net debt remains at a comfortable level of INR1,767 crore as on 31st March '26 versus INR1,395 crore

red_flags.label: Q4 PBDIT down, ROCE 13% from 14%
red_flags.quote: Return on capital employed for March '26 has come in at 13% as against 14% last year.

evasions.quote: it will be hard to give a number on this because it i s a forward -looking situation
So I think it i s very difficult to give an indication of what will be the prices going forward.
